phase_policies.applies_when: Early game around 180 seconds with unknown enemy posture, heavy economy and tech investment, moderate production, and expanding.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when more enemy composition info is available or upon reaching a tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on economy and tech, keep production steady, build ground forces for safety.
phase_policies.target: Develop economy and tech while maintaining production; strengthen ground army as a baseline.
phase_policies.title: Early Tech/Economy Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a large army before knowing enemy plan, nor over-expand without defense.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame around 240 seconds with ground-oriented posture, moderate production, heavy tech, and enemy ground cues (Zealot/Stalker) with heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when enemy tech direction becomes clearer (e.g., Colossus, Void Ray) or at new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground forces, expand economy, keep tech advancing, and maintain defensive readiness.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing ground army while increasing economy and expansions; maintain defense and tech progression.
phase_policies.title: Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect defense while expanding, nor commit to a single tech path without information.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame around 480 seconds with ground-oriented posture, heavy production and tech, and enemy ground composition including Colossus, Zealot, Stalker, Observer.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when sufficient anti-Colossus units are available or when enemy tech changes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Boost defense against Colossus, keep ground army strong, and adapt tech to counter threats.
phase_policies.target: Increase defensive capabilities and continue developing ground army; consider tech that counters Colossus such as Vikings or Liberators.
phase_policies.title: Ground Defense vs Colossus
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-Colossus measures while focusing solely on ground army.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame around 600 seconds with ground-oriented posture, heavy production and tech, moderate air presence, and enemy ground cues (Zealot/Stalker/Sentry/Immortal).
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when enemy tech direction changes or when a decisive army composition advantage is achieved.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Add air units for support, keep ground forces strong, and continue tech and defense.
phase_policies.target: Increase air presence while continuing to strengthen ground army; maintain defense and tech progression.
phase_policies.title: Ground with Air Support
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to air at the expense of ground defense or economy.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
